description.value: Over Time Beer Works is a craft microbrewery and taproom in Kimberley, BC — a mountain town it proudly calls Canada's highest city — brewing a year-round lineup of ales and an IPA alongside rotating seasonal releases available only in the taproom. The casual, locals-friendly atmosphere is described as a good spot to get trail tips and area information from people who actually know the place. Cyclists can also take beer to go in growlers or 'bulldogs' for off-sales, and the brewery closes its sustainability loop by sending spent grains to a local butcher and composting hop and yeast waste for a nearby farmers market.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is fully available and confirms an active microbrewery taproom at the OSM address. The contact page supplies a phone number absent from OSM and corroborates the address. Takeout is explicitly confirmed via growler and bulldog off-sales mentioned on the about page; no bike-specific amenities, washrooms, or Wi-Fi are mentioned anywhere on the site.
concerns: OSM has no phone number; phone 1.250.427.2426 sourced from website contact page only.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active microbrewery taproom with a functioning website, confirmed address, and growler off-sales — a useful stop for touring cyclists in Kimberley.
